text: おらっ　こんどは　ようしゃ　しねえぜ！

structure.jp: ようしゃ　しねえぜ！

patterns.name: 〜ない
patterns.explanation: ねえ is a rough, slurred way of saying ない, 'not'. しねえ = しない = 'won't do'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is a rough, tough-guy way of pushing your statement at the listener. しねえぜ = 'I won't, man'.
